plan.focus: Locating empirical field observations of informal e-waste burning and dismantling practices alongside audited outcome evaluations from implemented formal worker protection and collection programs.
plan.reason: Prior discovery yielded broad background guidance and research methodologies rather than concrete field-level evidence of informal recycling site exposures (EW-01) or post-implementation outcome assessments of formalization initiatives (EW-03).
hypotheses: Direct observational field studies in recognized informal hubs document specific open burning practices and adjacent residential contamination metrics that general academic surveys omit.

Targeted institutional pilot evaluations document quantifiable changes in worker toxicant burdens or dust exposure following the introduction of formal dismantling tools or designated collection centers.
